environment_setting: Country B, City X, where football matches are highly popular and often lead to heated emotions among fans
norm_base: Citizens Surrounding and attacking referees, athletes or other staff, disturbing order at cultural, sports and other mass events Warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: cheering for his team from the stands without causing any disturbance
legitimate.benefits: enjoys the game, supports his team, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: may feel frustrated if the team loses and he cannot express his anger

illegal.illegal_action: rushing onto the field to confront the referee after a controversial decision
illegal.benefits: expresses his anger, feels a sense of justice
illegal.costs: warning or fine up to 200 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: preventing John Doe from rushing onto the field
legitimate.benefits: maintains order, avoids legal trouble for herself
legitimate.costs: may face resistance or conflict with John Doe

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring John Doe's actions and not intervening
illegal.costs: if discovered, may face disciplinary action or fine
